title: AI friendly place I found for getting playtesters
author: Remarkable-Ebb6177
selftext:
I found this sick website a couple days ago and the feedback I got was very useful and I didn't have to pay anything. Just wanted to let you guys know about it in case you struggled to get feedback on your game like I did. 

I won't send my referral link because I'm not sure if that's allowed here or not. If it is let me know and I'll add it later :p

Anyways here it is [https://getplaytests.dev](https://getplaytests.dev)

They have a discord too that's got a good amount of people in there who talk about their games and the feedback they got.
